title: The Book That Never Left
premise_public: The library's records showed a book had been borrowed the previous night, but the only printed copy still sat on its usual shelf. No one had returned it.
solution_summary: The borrower checked out the electronic edition of the same title. The printed book never moved; the record referred to another format.

facts.text: The library offered electronic and printed copies of one title.
The checkout was for the electronic edition.
The printed copy stayed on its shelf.

acceptable_solutions: Someone borrowed the ebook while the printed book stayed on the shelf.
The loan was for an electronic edition and no print copy moved.
The library record was for a digital book, not the shelf copy.
hints: The same title can exist in more than one format.
A checkout does not always involve carrying an object away.
